ir.name: pairwise_margin_adaptive_scaled_bias_v6_mean_aggregation_fixed
ir.intuition: Maintain pairwise margin loss with adaptive scaled bias, replacing unsupported sign() with safe equivalent sign via division, aggregate by mean for stable scaling.
ir.pseudocode:
eps=1e-8
margin = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
abs_delta_rank_mean = mean(abs(delta_rank)) + eps
delta_rank_mean = mean(delta_rank)
delta_rank_var = mean((delta_rank - delta_rank_mean)^2) + eps
beta = 0.1 * exp(-5 * delta_rank_var)
# approximate sign(delta_rank) as delta_rank / (abs(delta_rank)+eps)
bias_dynamic = bias * (delta_rank / (abs(delta_rank)+eps)) * (abs(delta_rank)+0.1) / (abs_delta_rank_mean+0.1)
scaled_bias = tanh(gamma * bias_dynamic)
margin_scale_raw = sqrt(clamp(delta_rank_var,eps)) / abs_delta_rank_mean
margin_scale = 1.5 / (1 + exp(-5 * (margin_scale_raw - 0.1)))
scaled_margin = margin * margin_scale
weighted_margin = alpha * scaled_margin - beta * delta_rank
biased_margin = weighted_margin + scaled_bias
x = clamp(biased_margin, -15, 15)
loss_per_pair = -logsigmoid(x)
loss = mean(loss_per_pair * weight)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']

    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    bias = float(extra.get('bias', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('bias', 0.5)))
    gamma = float(extra.get('gamma', 2.0))

    eps = 1e-8
    abs_delta_rank = ops.abs(delta_rank)
    abs_delta_rank_mean = ops.mean(abs_delta_rank) + eps
    delta_rank_mean = ops.mean(delta_rank)
    delta_rank_var = ops.mean(ops.mul(ops.sub(delta_rank, delta_rank_mean), ops.sub(delta_rank, delta_rank_mean))) + eps

    beta = ops.mul(0.1, ops.exp(ops.neg(ops.mul(delta_rank_var, 5.0))))

    sign_delta_rank = ops.div(delta_rank, ops.add(abs_delta_rank, eps))

    bias_dynamic = ops.mul(bias, ops.mul(sign_delta_rank, ops.div(ops.add(abs_delta_rank, 0.1), ops.add(abs_delta_rank_mean, 0.1))))
    scaled_bias = ops.tanh(ops.mul(gamma, bias_dynamic))

    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    margin_scale_raw = ops.div(ops.sqrt(delta_rank_var.clamp(min=eps)), abs_delta_rank_mean)
    margin_scale = ops.mul(1.5, ops.div(ops.ones_like(margin_scale_raw), ops.add(ops.ones_like(margin_scale_raw), ops.exp(ops.neg(ops.mul(5.0, ops.sub(margin_scale_raw, 0.1)))))))
    scaled_margin = ops.mul(margin, margin_scale)

    weighted_margin = ops.sub(ops.mul(alpha, scaled_margin), ops.mul(beta, delta_rank))
    biased_margin = ops.add(weighted_margin, scaled_bias)
    x = ops.clamp(biased_margin, -15.0, 15.0)

    loss_per_pair = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_per_pair, weight)
    loss = ops.mean(weighted_loss)
    return loss
